nodes.label: assemble.py
nodes.rationale: Turns raw research into profile, place cards, sources and image choices.

nodes.label: validate (validator / npm run check)
nodes.rationale: Checks links, blocks 'tribe' in titles, reports capital warnings.

nodes.label: vq.py (script-verified quotes)
nodes.rationale: Stricter rule: a fact enters only if a script downloads the page with curl and finds the quote; 621 quotes over 209 pages, none missing. Lives outside repo.

nodes.label: 'What is happening in Africa today' section
nodes.norm_label: 'what is happening in africa today' section
nodes.rationale: Sensitive topic: distinguish court/UN-established vs accused; dated updates; small batches and human reread.

nodes.label: Art catalogue
nodes.rationale: Not an undifferentiated gallery: short cards with context, place, community, period, materials, function, reproduction licence; grew from 25 to 63 entries; distinguish viewable vs reusable images.
nodes.source_location: Un altro lato da esplorare: arte / Arte

nodes.label: Capital profiles (54)
nodes.rationale: Same interactive format as stories plus 3-5 non-UNESCO places to see; researched region by region; all 54 published on 17 Nov 2026 after source verification.

nodes.label: Country pages (54, generated from data)
nodes.rationale: Auto-update when new cards and stories enter.

nodes.label: Food and recipes survey (five layers)
nodes.rationale: Cuisine treated not as catalogue of 'typical' dishes: recognised practices, ingredients/food systems, techniques, places and people, publishable recipes; never claim one 'authentic' version.

nodes.label: gaps field
nodes.rationale: Each content item records what is not known, missing or to be checked.

nodes.label: Local voices (contribution form)
nodes.rationale: At least one local reader per batch; invited for each capital profile and people card, with consent.

nodes.label: Objects that do things (art category)
nodes.rationale: Explain function and context instead of presenting objects as exotic.

nodes.label: Peoples section
nodes.rationale: Started after capitals; 'tribe' is colonial-era and contested so use peoples/ethnic groups; no generalised traits; member voices separated from documented record; card not published without review by a member or scholar (reviewedBy).

nodes.label: Phase 1: Stories
nodes.rationale: Batches of 5-6 balancing history, myths to debunk, food; each story feeds 1-2 quiz questions.

nodes.label: Phase 2: Places
nodes.rationale: Two more non-UNESCO places per country of different types; open-licence photos with credit; documented only with non-UNESCO sources.

nodes.label: Phase 3: Dishes
nodes.rationale: One dish per country as type 'dish'; no 'national dish' claim without a serious source; high-confidence first; shared dishes become one multi-country card.

nodes.label: Phase 4: Paths (reading trails)
nodes.rationale: Thematic sequences of 5-8 stops linking places, stories, dishes and data with opening and closing questions.

nodes.label: Quiz
nodes.rationale: Grows with stories, two questions per story; art quiz questions still missing.

nodes.label: Quote verification (2026-11-15)
nodes.rationale: 459/807 quotes found; claims resting only on 35 non-matching URLs removed from 67 files; 19 capitals left thin and re-researched.

nodes.label: Story model ('The children Italy did not recognise')
nodes.norm_label: story model ('the children italy did not recognise')
nodes.rationale: Template: In short box, numbers, estimate, chronology, ordering game, charts/tables, questions, open-licence images.

nodes.label: UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage
nodes.rationale: Starting point, not a ranking of authenticity; UNESCO blocks automated requests (403).

nodes.label: Africa on the Ground
nodes.rationale: Educational interactive static site for adults about the 54 African countries; teaches by doing; explicitly not a travel guide. Success = visitor corrects an assumption and knows what is documented vs one person's account.

nodes.label: Landing page brief (Read / Look / Play / Contribute)
nodes.norm_label: landing page brief (read / look / play / contribute)
nodes.rationale: Organise entry by way of engaging, each with a live preview of real content; present the project and method rather than dump every item. Visual identity is kept; only structure changes.

nodes.label: Curious adults (primary users)
nodes.rationale: Adults who know little beyond headlines and arrive without a starting point; teachers and people from African countries served by Method and contribution pages instead of the landing.

nodes.label: Piano dei contenuti (content plan)
nodes.rationale: Phased plan: stories, places, dishes, paths; each phase in short batches reread by a person before the next.

nodes.label: Interactivity as base of every section (shared block family)
nodes.norm_label: interactivity as base of every section (shared block family)
nodes.rationale: Stories, place cards, capital profiles, Method page and data pages use the same block family; Method built from content/pages/method.json with counts computed at build.

nodes.label: Quality rule (sources, gaps, verification)
nodes.rationale: Every sentence sourced or declared as comment; no figure without year and source; at least one non-UNESCO non-Wikipedia source else 'outline'; blocked sources replaced never invented; npm run check + phone check + human reread after each batch.

nodes.label: Avoid 'tribe' as a category
nodes.rationale: Use 'peoples' or 'ethnic groups' instead.

nodes.label: Honest content status (drafts)
nodes.rationale: Most place, capital, people and art pages are drafts awaiting human review; landing must not imply completeness.

nodes.label: Static site, no data collection
nodes.rationale: No database, cookies, tracking; scores live only on the page; local fonts so no third-party requests; contributed notes arrive by hand with consent.

nodes.label: Two layers: documented record vs local voices
nodes.norm_label: two layers: documented record vs local voices
nodes.rationale: Every documented claim has a numbered, labelled source and each page states what is not known; local voices are one person's experience, never presented as fact.
